newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures end little higher in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures end little higher in thin trade.

text.p: CME lumber futures ended slightly higher on scattered short-covering as trading remained light, traders said.

Futures showed little interest as the market awaits fresh direction from the cash market. Cash trade has been slow as mills hold asking prices on possible large order files while wholesalers continue to look for counters to sell their wood, traders said.
Lumber closed $2.90 to $1.10 per tbf higher with May up $1.30 at $397.50 and July up $2.90 at $396.50 per tbf.
